title: gagea uniflora
intro: Gagea uniflora, commonly known as the one-flowered gagea, is a species of flowering plant in the lily family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Gagea uniflora include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiviral and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of Gagea uniflora include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
